statement: Let T be a smooth projective manifold, Z ⊂ T a smooth closed submanifold of positive codimension, possibly disconnected, and L an ample 19 rational polarization. Let T′ = BlZ T, Y = PZ(1 ⊕ NZ/T ), D∞ = PZ(NZ/T ) ⊂ Y. Write EZ for the exceptional divisor on T′; when Z is a divisor, T′ ≃ T and EZ means Z. Suppose d > 0 is rational and π∗ L − dEZ on T′ , L|Z + dU on Y are ample. Let F ⊂ T be a finite union of pairwise disjoint smooth closed complex submanifolds. Assume the inverse image of F ∩ Z under Y → Z is also a finite union of pairwise disjoint smooth complex submanifolds; the empty union is allowed. Let ωT be any Kähler form in class L, and let ωY be a Kähler form in class L|Z + dU, invariant under scalar rotation of the normal summand. Then every compact subset of Y \ (︁ D∞ ∪ π−1 Y (F ∩ Z) )︁ has a neighborhood admitting a symplectic embedding into (T \ F, ωT ), with its given form ωY . In particular any compact packing there transfers with neighborhood embeddings.
